def transform_first_of_group(pattern, filler=1):
    result = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(pattern):
        val = pattern[i]
        j = i
        while j < len(pattern) and pattern[j] == val:
            j += 1
        result.append(filler)
        for k in range(i + 1, j):
            result.append(pattern[k])
        i = j
    return result
